_about: Family layer rules (v2). Families group entities; entities, entity ids and notes are never changed. Merges are rule-based only (stem, library cue, template) and are applied with union-find within one Category. Embedding similarity never merges; it only lists candidates for review. The digit guard does not apply to families. Regexes are Python, case-insensitive.

spelling_us._description: British -> American word map, applied to lowercased names before stems, templates and the duplicate check.

stem._description: Lowercase the canonical name (spelling_us applied); remove parenthetical / bracketed text (parameters, acronyms, instance details); split into letter runs and digit runs; drop digit runs except 4-digit years 1990-2039, F/G function numbers, size tokens, instance ids (instance_prefixes / explicit_instances), the words below; keep the remaining alphabetic tokens in order. Two entities in one Category with the same non-empty stem are merged.

instance_ids._description: A token that is a library instance id: one of instance_prefixes (at least 3 letters) followed by digits, or a name in explicit_instances. Fixed from Part 1: one- and two-letter prefixes (a, d, u, ch, pr, st, gr, ...) no longer match on their own; only the explicit names below.
instance_ids.bare_instance_stem: A name that is only an instance id gets the stem '<library> instance' (e.g. 'qaplib instance'), so bare instances of one library form one family.

library_cue._description: A cue found on the entity's rows in Dataset_Name or Source_Platform. Each entity gets at most one cue: the one on most of its rows (ties: list order). Entities in one Category with the same cue are merged. 'CEC <year>' keeps the year, so different years stay separate.

template._description: Within one Category, names with at least min_tokens tokens (lowercased, spelling_us applied, parenthetical text removed, split on non-alphanumerics) whose token sequences differ by at most max_token_edits token insertions / deletions / substitutions are merged (union-find, so a grid of settings joins one family). No embedding similarity is used.

standard_suite_regex._description: Names of standard benchmark suites / libraries. Used ONLY for the reuse signal 'standard_suite_name' (on any member's canonical name or alias), never to merge.

embedding_candidates._description: Review list only: same-Category entity pairs in different families with cosine >= threshold on entity_embeddings_v2.npy.

possible_duplicates._description: Report only, entity ids unchanged: canonical-name pairs with the same token set (any order), or Levenshtein distance <= 1, after lowercasing and spelling_us.
